address: 600 Baughs Cross Road, West Point, GA 31833

feeding_claim.verbatim: Cattle in our beef program are no different other than having access to a supplemental grain for 90 days prior to harvest.

notes: Black Angus cattle farm run by Marc and Avery Claire Wrigglesworth, third generation family farm. Checked the homepage, our story page, FAQ, shipping FAQ, local pickup page and the all products page. The FAQ says cattle live on pasture all year with grass in season and hay in winter, then get supplemental grain (mainly soybean hulls) for 90 days before harvest, and that the beef is not advertised as 100% grass-finished; the homepage says grass and grain finished. Beef is dry aged at least 14 days. Ships to all lower 48 states (flat rate ground to a list of eastern states, next day air elsewhere). Local pickup after ordering online at 600 Baughs Cross Road, West Point, which is the only place the site gives a town; a local news story also places the farm near West Point in Troup County. Quarter, half and whole beef shares are pickup only. No phone on the site, email only. Also sells tallow skincare and sea salt.
